name: C.A.T. ~Cyber Attack Team~
original_name: C.A.T 〜サイバーアタックチーム〜
source: C.A.T. Cyber Attack Team's story takes place in the cyberspace of the computer network, where you must defend the peace and battle against monsters and viruses who attempt to attack the network. There are a total of 14 chapters, each chapter is divided into adventure part and simulation part. During the battle, the members of the CAT team can transform into powerful CAT heroines once they are inside the cyberspace.
